publication.citation: Gress, M.U., Howell, D., Chinn, I.L., Speich, L., Kohn, S.C., van den Heuvel, Q., Schulten, E., Pals, A.S.M., Davies, G.R. (2018). Episodic diamond growth beneath the Kaapvaal Craton at Jwaneng Mine, Botswana. Mineralogy and Petrology 112 (Suppl 1), S219-S229.
publication.notes: Table 2 (p. S226): averaged major elements of 46 liberated clinopyroxene and garnet inclusions. Printed totals are low (91.8-100.4 wt%): the inclusions were analysed unpolished. Not extracted: Table 1 (inclusion proportions) and the nitrogen (FTIR) data of the host diamonds.

tool: extraction/extract.py (pdftotext -layout; hints in this file under "extract"; table checked against a page image of p. S226) + scripts/build_gold.py

method.conditions: JEOL JXA-8350F electron microprobe (Utrecht University); 15 kV, 25 nA, 1 µm beam; CITZAF correction. Inclusions were liberated, mounted unpolished on carbon tape and analysed on a horizontal surface. Data treatment follows Timmerman et al. (2015): normalisation to 100% and only measurements within 2 standard deviations of the mean.

localities.name: Jwaneng
localities.excerpt: run of mine production was examined from Jwaneng Mine (north, centre and south pipes)

Table 2.footnote: '–' (Cr2O3 of JW137 cpx D and JW137 gnt B) is not defined in Table 2
Table 2.zone_note: Zone = approximate location of inclusion in core, intermediate (int) and rim zones based on visual observation only (Table 2 footnote); '?' as printed

total_tolerance_note: Table 2 prints averages rounded to 1 or 2 decimals, so the eleven printed oxides can differ from the printed Total by up to about 0.33 wt% through rounding alone; the largest difference found is 0.17.
